annotation.title_clean: 关于印发《服务业发展资金管理办法》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Administrative Measures for Service Industry Development Funds
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 财政部; 商务部 (Ministry of Finance; Ministry of Commerce, China)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Finance of the PRC (财建〔2026〕137号)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Commerce measures governing the central service-industry development fund, covering scope, allocation methods, application procedures, performance evaluation and oversight. AI is mentioned only as one consumer-sector application to promote. Replaces the 2023 measures.
key_provisions_or_claims: Fund runs to 2028 and supports consumption growth, commerce and logistics competitiveness.
Allocation by formula (60% development, 30% budget execution, 10% regional tilt), project method, or both.
Funds may not be misappropriated or used for debt repayment or duplicate applications.
Performance management and supervision by finance bureaus; violations carry liability under the Budget Law.
